sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举办的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, Hurricane Irma roars into Florida, where, in the wake of Hurricane Harvey, an apocalyptic forecast forced one of the largest evacuations in American history.
sentences.zh: 今天，飓风“艾尔玛”咆哮着进入佛罗里达州。此前，在飓风“哈维”过后，末日般的预报迫使该州进行了美国历史上最大规模的疏散行动之一。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月11日，星期一。

sentences.en: Yesterday, at noon, I signed a declaration of emergency in the city of Miami.
sentences.zh: 昨天中午，我签署了迈阿密市的紧急状态声明。

sentences.en: For days, Hurricane Irma was expected to strike Miami with catastrophic force, prompting massive evacuations that cleared out much of the city.
sentences.zh: 几天来，飓风“艾尔玛”预计将以灾难性的威力袭击迈阿密，促使大规模疏散，清空了城市的大部分地区。

sentences.en: If you've been ordered to evacuate, you need to leave now.
sentences.zh: 如果你收到了疏散令，你现在就得离开。

sentences.en: Do not wait.
sentences.zh: 别等了。

sentences.en: Evacuate.
sentences.zh: 撤离吧。

sentences.en: Not tonight, not in an hour.
sentences.zh: 不是今晚，也不是一小时后。

sentences.en: You need to go right now.
sentences.zh: 你现在就得走。

sentences.en: By Saturday, Governor Rick Scott had ordered nearly 6 million people to leave their homes, most of them on Florida's east coaSt.
sentences.zh: 到周六，里克·斯科特州长已下令近600万人离开家园，他们大多居住在佛罗里达州东海岸。

sentences.en: But then...
sentences.zh: 但随后……

sentences.en: When Hurricane Irma's projected path shifted west to the Gulf Coast city of Tampa overnight, thousands began to take the threat more seriously and started scrambling.
sentences.zh: 当飓风“艾尔玛”的预计路径在一夜之间向西转移到墨西哥湾沿岸城市坦帕时，成千上万的人开始更认真地对待这一威胁，并开始匆忙撤离。

sentences.en: The storm changed course, heading for Florida's west coaSt.
sentences.zh: 风暴改变了路线，直奔佛罗里达州西海岸。

sentences.en: Tampa Mayor Bob Buckhorn is with us.
sentences.zh: 坦帕市市长鲍勃·巴克霍恩和我们在一起。

sentences.en: Mayor Buckhorn, how prepared are you?
sentences.zh: 巴克霍恩市长，你们准备得如何？

sentences.en: And the city of Tampa.
sentences.zh: 还有坦帕市。

sentences.en: You know, I never thought I would quote Mike Tyson in saying, everyone has a plan until they get punched in the face.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从没想过我会引用迈克·泰森的话，他说，每个人都有计划，直到他们被一拳打在脸上。

sentences.en: Well, we're about to be punched in the face tomorrow, so we're going to see how this plan holds up.
sentences.zh: 好吧，明天我们就要被“打在脸上”了，所以我们要看看这个计划能坚持多久。

sentences.en: In Miami, Gene Eisen had ignored the evacuation orders.
sentences.zh: 在迈阿密，吉恩·艾森无视了疏散令。

sentences.en: Hi, Gene, it's Michael Barbaro from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 你好，吉恩，我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm fine, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我很好，谢谢。

sentences.en: Mike told me you would be calling.
sentences.zh: 迈克告诉我你会打电话来。

sentences.en: Yes, and thank you for letting us give you a call.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢你让我们给你打电话。

sentences.en: You speak a little louder because...
sentences.zh: 你能大声一点吗，因为……

sentences.en: Yes, I said thank you for letting us give you a call.
sentences.zh: 是的，我说谢谢你让我们给你打电话。

sentences.en: What is it you want to know?
sentences.zh: 你想知道什么？

sentences.en: I want to know how you're doing.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你现在怎么样。

sentences.en: I'm doing fine.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: You are?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Except for no air conditioning and no electricity.
sentences.zh: 除了没有空调和电力。

sentences.en: Well, those are two big ones.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那可是两个大问题。

sentences.en: I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But I've had that before, so what can I tell you?
sentences.zh: 但我以前也经历过，所以我能说什么呢？

sentences.en: Is it pitch black in your apartment?
sentences.zh: 你的公寓里漆黑一片吗？

sentences.en: Can you see anything?
sentences.zh: 你能看见什么吗？

sentences.en: No, it's not pitch black, dark.
sentences.zh: 不，不是漆黑一片，很暗。

sentences.en: First of all, I have a lantern here, and I have several small flashlights that I can use.
sentences.zh: 首先，我这里有一盏灯，还有几个可以用的小手电筒。

sentences.en: You always have to prepare.
sentences.zh: 你总是要做好准备。

sentences.en: How many hurricanes do you think you have been through in Miami?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你在迈阿密经历过多少次飓风了？

sentences.en: You know, honestly, I don't remember.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不记得了。

sentences.en: But a lot?
sentences.zh: 但是很多次？

sentences.en: Yes, quite a few.
sentences.zh: 是的，不少次。

sentences.en: So I stayed for, what was it, Andrew?
sentences.zh: 所以我留下来了，那是哪一次来着，安德鲁？

sentences.en: Okay, wow.
sentences.zh: 好的，哇。

sentences.en: That was another big decision.
sentences.zh: 那又是另一个重大的决定。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I've been here in Florida for the past 70 years.
sentences.zh: 我在佛罗里达住了70年了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow is right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对，确实是“哇”。

sentences.en: And I've always stayed in my home, never had too much trouble.
sentences.zh: 我一直待在家里，从来没出过什么大问题。

sentences.en: And this building that I'm in, which is almost 40 years, and I figured that the building of this size would be easier to stay in than going to a shelter with so many people.
sentences.zh: 我住的这栋楼有近40年了，我想这种规模的建筑比去收容所和那么多人挤在一起更容易待着。

sentences.en: I figured the worst that could happen, I'll sit out on a chair in the hallway where there are no windows.
sentences.zh: 我想最坏的情况就是，我会坐在走廊里没有窗户的椅子上。

sentences.en: The only two windows I was concerned about was the one in my bedroom and the one in my dining room, which is from ceiling to floor.
sentences.zh: 我唯一担心的两扇窗户是我卧室和餐厅里的，那是从天花板到地板的落地窗。

sentences.en: And I don't have any shutters on that.
sentences.zh: 而且我上面没有装百叶窗。

sentences.en: So your grandson and my colleague, Michael, told us that we should call you.
sentences.zh: 所以你的孙子，我的同事迈克尔，告诉我们应该给你打电话。

sentences.en: And he very— I know when I'm going to murder him.
sentences.zh: 他非常——我知道我什么时候会杀了他。

sentences.en: Well, he very lovingly said that after pleading with you over and over again to leave, this was his quote,
sentences.zh: 嗯，他非常深情地说，在反复恳求你离开后，这是他的原话：

sentences.en: I've given up trying to reason with her, so I figured at least I can put her to work.
sentences.zh: “我已经放弃试图说服她了，所以我心想至少我可以让她干点活。”

sentences.en: That's exactly what he told me.
sentences.zh: 他就是这么告诉我的。

sentences.en: He's his quote, you work for me.
sentences.zh: 他的原话是，你为我工作。

sentences.en: And for the times.
sentences.zh: 还有为《时报》工作。

sentences.en: And Michael, I'd do anything for her anyway.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，反正我什么都愿意为她做。

sentences.en: Except leave.
sentences.zh: 除了离开。

sentences.en: Except that one thing.
sentences.zh: 除了那一件事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's about 7.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 现在是周日晚上7点半左右。

sentences.en: on Sunday evening, and it sounds like parts of Miami are flooding pretty significantly.
sentences.zh: 听起来迈阿密部分地区的水灾相当严重。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I'm not concerned so much about the flooding, because I don't go out anyway, so it doesn't make much difference to me.
sentences.zh: 是的，嗯，我不太担心洪水，因为反正我也不出门，所以对我来说没什么区别。

sentences.en: And I'm up on the fifth floor.
sentences.zh: 而且我住在五楼。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And if I were flooded up to the fifth floor, everybody would be in big trouble here.
sentences.zh: 如果洪水淹到五楼，这里的所有人都会有大麻烦。

sentences.en: I made hard-boiled eggs before the electricity went off.
sentences.zh: 在停电之前，我煮了些鸡蛋。

sentences.en: That was smart.
sentences.zh: 那很聪明。

sentences.en: And I always have peanut butter, which I like anyway.
sentences.zh: 而且我总是有花生酱，反正我也喜欢吃。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's canned stuff like sardines, tuna fish, whatever.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，还有罐头食品，比如沙丁鱼、金枪鱼之类的。

sentences.en: If anything goes bad, I always have something to eat.
sentences.zh: 如果有什么东西坏了，我总有东西吃。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: And you said you have a home health aide there.
sentences.zh: 你说你那里有居家护理员。

sentences.en: So it sounds like if something happened, you're not alone.
sentences.zh: 听起来如果发生了什么事，你并不是一个人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: I don't know if Michael told you how old I was.
sentences.zh: 我不知道迈克尔有没有告诉你我多大了。

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 他说了。

sentences.en: But you should tell the listeners.
sentences.zh: 但你应该告诉听众。
我90岁了。

sentences.en: I'll be 94 soon.
sentences.zh: 我很快就94岁了。

sentences.en: That's remarkable.
sentences.zh: 那太了不起了。

sentences.en: No, it's not.
sentences.zh: 不，没什么。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实了不起。

sentences.en: Michael seems to think I am.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔似乎觉得是这样。

sentences.en: Because I still have all my marbles, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想是因为我头脑还很清醒吧。

sentences.en: Do you think that your age has something to do with why you're not willing to leave?
sentences.zh: 你认为你的年龄和你为什么不愿意离开有关系吗？

sentences.en: That age permits you to be stubborn?
sentences.zh: 年龄让你变得固执？

sentences.en: I don't think it's my age, because I went through so many when I was much younger.
sentences.zh: 我不认为是年龄的原因，因为我年轻的时候经历过很多次。

sentences.en: My mind was made up long ago.
sentences.zh: 我的主意很久以前就定下来了。

sentences.en: I regardless what my family said.
sentences.zh: 不管我的家人怎么说。

sentences.en: Well, it sounds like, as kind of meteorological fate has it, that you kind of lucked out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，听起来，正如气象命运所安排的那样，你算是走运了。

sentences.en: Because the storm that was supposed to hit Miami went west, and it's now going to places like Fort Myers and Naples, the other side of the peninsula.
sentences.zh: 因为本该袭击迈阿密的风暴转向了西方，现在正前往麦尔兹堡和那不勒斯等地，也就是半岛的另一侧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It sounds like you got lucky with the direction of the storm.
sentences.zh: 听起来你在风暴方向上很幸运。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I don't know how much damage is done outside, because I'm not looking.
sentences.zh: 我不知道外面造成了多大的破坏，因为我没看。

sentences.en: Well, right now it's dark, so you can't find anything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在天黑了，所以你什么也看不见。

sentences.en: And I have the storm shutters on my sliding glass doors, and I'm not going to open that.
sentences.zh: 我的推拉门上装了防风百叶窗，我不会打开它的。

sentences.en: So I'll see what happens tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 所以我明天早上再看看情况。

sentences.en: Well, I wish you the best of luck tonight, and I hope when you wake up and you open those doors that there is as little damage as possible, Jean.
sentences.zh: 好吧，祝你今晚好运，吉恩，我希望当你醒来打开门时，破坏尽可能小。

sentences.en: And I'm really grateful for your time, and I'm glad that you are safe, and I'm going to report to Michael that you are doing well.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感谢你抽出时间，很高兴你是安全的，我会向迈克尔报告你一切都好。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: An hour later, I reached Antonella Gianantonio on the other side of the state.
sentences.zh: 一小时后，我联系上了在州另一侧的安东内拉·吉安安东尼奥。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Hi, Antonella.
sentences.zh: 你好，安东内拉。

sentences.en: It's Michael Barbaro from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: So I guess we should tell people, you're on a cell phone in the middle of the hurricane, so it shouldn't be a surprise that occasionally the connection might get a little dodgy.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该告诉大家，你是在飓风中用手机通话，所以偶尔连接有点不稳定也不足为奇。

sentences.en: Yeah, let me sort of hear.
sentences.zh: 是的，让我听听。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So you can hear me now.
sentences.zh: 现在你能听到我说话了。

sentences.en: Yes, I can.
sentences.zh: 是的，我可以。

sentences.en: Good, good, good.
sentences.zh: 很好，很好，很好。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Antonella, where am I reaching you right now?
sentences.zh: 那么，安东内拉，我现在是在哪里联系到你的？

sentences.en: I'm in Tampa, Florida.
sentences.zh: 我在佛罗里达州的坦帕。

sentences.en: And what kind of a building are you in?
sentences.zh: 你住的是什么样的建筑？

sentences.en: I'm at the residence in Marriott.
sentences.zh: 我在万豪旗下的Residence Inn酒店。

sentences.en: So you're in a hotel.
sentences.zh: 所以你在酒店里。

sentences.en: It only has three floors.
sentences.zh: 它只有三层楼。

sentences.en: Oh, that's pretty low.
sentences.zh: 哦，那挺低的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So who are you with in this hotel?
sentences.zh: 那么你和谁在这家酒店里？

sentences.en: My parents are here.
sentences.zh: 我的父母在这里。

sentences.en: My 88-year-old dad, my 85-year-old mom.
sentences.zh: 我88岁的父亲，我85岁的母亲。

sentences.en: My sister is here visiting me also.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹也在这儿看望我。

sentences.en: I have a 10-year-old son, my cat, and Jason.
sentences.zh: 我有一个10岁的儿子，还有我的猫，以及杰森。

sentences.en: Your husband.
sentences.zh: 你丈夫。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, as you know, you're right in the path of Hurricane Irma.
sentences.zh: 所以，如你所知，你们正处于飓风“艾尔玛”的路径上。

sentences.en: And from what I understand, you did everything in your power to try to make sure that you wouldn't be in the path of the storm.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，你们已经尽了全力，试图确保自己不会处于风暴路径上。

sentences.en: So take me through the past few days and kind of help me understand where you started and how you ended up in Tampa.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我讲讲过去几天的情况，让我了解一下你们是从哪儿出发的，又是怎么最终到了坦帕的。

sentences.en: Well, I live in North Miami Beach.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我住在北迈阿密海滩。

sentences.en: We were advised that we would be evacuated.
sentences.zh: 我们接到通知说要撤离。

sentences.en: And Wednesday, we rushed and packed everything up.
sentences.zh: 周三那天，我们匆忙打包好了一切。

sentences.en: And we left that evening and we headed towards Naples.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我们就出发了，朝那不勒斯方向走。

sentences.en: And we stopped there and spent the night there.
sentences.zh: 我们在那儿停下来，过了一夜。

sentences.en: And the next morning, you know, we were told that we'd be safe if we keep heading north.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，你知道的，有人告诉我们，如果我们继续向北走，就会安全。

sentences.en: So we went to Tampa.
sentences.zh: 所以我们就去了坦帕。

sentences.en: We thought we'd be safe over here.
sentences.zh: 我们以为在那儿会很安全。

sentences.en: And why did you think you would be safe?
sentences.zh: 那你为什么觉得在那儿会安全呢？

sentences.en: At that point, it just looked like the storm was...
sentences.zh: 当时看来，风暴似乎……

sentences.en: Was coming nowhere here.
sentences.zh: 根本不会到这儿来。

sentences.en: That's what they kept on saying.
sentences.zh: 他们一直都是这么说的。

sentences.en: Evacuate Miami.
sentences.zh: 撤离迈阿密。

sentences.en: Evacuate Miami.
sentences.zh: 撤离迈阿密。

sentences.en: Evacuate Miami.
sentences.zh: 撤离迈阿密。

sentences.en: Was it difficult to actually make that trip?
sentences.zh: 那趟行程真的很难吗？

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Traffic.
sentences.zh: 交通堵塞。

sentences.en: Car accidents.
sentences.zh: 车祸频发。

sentences.en: It was very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 非常危险。

sentences.en: You know, you're concerned that you're not going to make it to the next stop with your gas that you have in your car.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你会担心车里的油不够，没法开到下一站。

sentences.en: The supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 超市里。

sentences.en: Costco.
sentences.zh: 好市多。

sentences.en: It was just a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 简直是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: There were a lot of people helping each other out.
sentences.zh: 有很多人在互相帮助。

sentences.en: But then there were a lot of people, unfortunately, that, you know, were panicked.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，也有很多人，你知道的，陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: So they feared and, you know, people fear they do stupid things.
sentences.zh: 所以他们感到害怕，而你知道，人们一害怕就会做蠢事。

sentences.en: And, you know, they're cutting lines, starting fights.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们插队、打架。

sentences.en: Right in my hotel that I'm in right now, one of the hotel guests had gasoline in his car.
sentences.zh: 就在我现在住的这家酒店里，其中一位客人的车里有汽油。

sentences.en: And they broke in his car and they took his gas.
sentences.zh: 结果有人撬了他的车，把油偷走了。

sentences.en: Oh, that's horrible.
sentences.zh: 噢，那太可怕了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: They're stealing water.
sentences.zh: 他们连水都偷。

sentences.en: People are, it's a panic.
sentences.zh: 人们……这是一种恐慌。

sentences.en: It's a state of panic.
sentences.zh: 这是一种恐慌状态。

sentences.en: So how long did you have to search to find a hotel room?
sentences.zh: 那你花了多久才找到酒店房间？

sentences.en: When we left Naples Thursday and we got here Friday, we stopped at a few hotels and they didn't have anything.
sentences.zh: 我们周四离开那不勒斯，周五到达这里，我们问了几家酒店，他们都没房了。

sentences.en: But we did most of it on the telephone.
sentences.zh: 但我们大部分时间是在电话里联系的。

sentences.en: I would say we called about, maybe about five, five.
sentences.zh: 我想我们大概打了五家，五家左右吧。

sentences.en: And then you could see on the internet, they're all sold out.
sentences.zh: 然后你在网上也能看到，全都订满了。

sentences.en: There's nothing available anywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都没有空房。

sentences.en: Anywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是。

sentences.en: They keep going.
sentences.zh: 他们还在继续撤离。

sentences.en: And, I mean, this hotel is packed with people.
sentences.zh: 而且，我是说，这家酒店挤满了人。

sentences.en: There's no hotels anywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都没有酒店了。

sentences.en: This is a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 这简直是噩梦。

sentences.en: At what point did you realize that in fleeing Miami, instead of getting away from the storm, you were actually, through no fault of your own,
sentences.zh: 你是在什么时候意识到，在逃离迈阿密时，你并没有躲开风暴，而是——并非你的过错，

sentences.en: just the fate and twists and turns of this, you were actually going towards the storm?
sentences.zh: 仅仅是命运的捉弄和转折——你实际上是在朝着风暴走去？

sentences.en: Well, we realized that on Friday, actually.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实我们周五就意识到了。

sentences.en: We were a little concerned.
sentences.zh: 我们当时有点担心。

sentences.en: You know, my sister, that's the very first thing she says, oh, my God, this storm is chasing us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我妹妹说的第一句话就是，噢天哪，这风暴在追着我们跑。

sentences.en: You know, we can't get away from it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们根本躲不开它。

sentences.en: So why did you decide to stay in Tampa after you learned that the storm had shifted in that direction?
sentences.zh: 那么，在得知风暴已经转向那个方向后，你为什么决定留在坦帕呢？

sentences.en: Well, because at this point, there would be no guarantee that I would be safe if I were to leave, to go someplace else.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为到了这个地步，如果我离开去别的地方，也不能保证我就安全了。

sentences.en: If I keep heading north, it's just going to come follow me.
sentences.zh: 如果我继续向北走，它还是会跟过来。

sentences.en: So I just assumed staying here.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是觉得还是留在这儿吧。

sentences.en: I did have a lot of my friends call me and, you know, tell me that they were going to be heading back to Miami.
sentences.zh: 确实有很多朋友给我打电话，你知道的，告诉我他们打算回迈阿密。

sentences.en: But then they started talking about the tornado watches in Miami and I just said to myself and my sister made the decision also that, you know,
sentences.zh: 但后来他们开始谈论迈阿密的龙卷风预警，我就对自己说，我妹妹也做了同样的决定，你知道，

sentences.en: I was just going to stay and when it's over, we're leaving.
sentences.zh: 我决定留下来，等风暴结束了我们再走。

sentences.en: So just quickly, what's the scene there now?
sentences.zh: 那么简单问一下，那儿现在是什么情况？

sentences.en: It sounds like you've been able to look out the windows now and then.
sentences.zh: 听起来你偶尔能往窗外看一看。

sentences.en: What are you seeing?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: I can't look out the windows because everything's, you know, locked up.
sentences.zh: 我没法往窗外看，因为所有东西，你知道的，都封死了。

sentences.en: But it's just raining very heavily here.
sentences.zh: 但这里雨下得非常大。

sentences.en: The winds are picking up.
sentences.zh: 风力正在加强。

sentences.en: The lights in our room flickered.
sentences.zh: 我们房间里的灯闪烁了一下。

sentences.en: But they're reporting that, you know, in the middle of the night till the morning, it's going to be bad.
sentences.zh: 但据报道，你知道的，从半夜到早上，情况会很糟糕。

sentences.en: But I think within an hour, an hour or two, it's going to start getting really bad here.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在一两个小时内，这里的情况会变得非常严重。

sentences.en: Antonelle, do you have any idea what to expect back in north Miami where your house is?
sentences.zh: 安托内拉，你对北迈阿密你家的情况有什么预感吗？

sentences.en: I'm afraid to ask.
sentences.zh: 我不敢问。

sentences.en: So I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道。

sentences.en: I know that downtown Miami is underwater.
sentences.zh: 我知道迈阿密市中心已经被淹了。

sentences.en: I know a lot of areas are underwater.
sentences.zh: 我知道很多地区都被淹了。

sentences.en: My area floods for any time it rains and there's thunderstorMs.
sentences.zh: 我住的地方只要一下雨或者有雷暴就会淹水。

sentences.en: I can only imagine now.
sentences.zh: 我现在只能想象那里的情况了。

sentences.en: Antonella, thank you very much for talking with me.
sentences.zh: 安托内拉，非常感谢你接受我的采访。

sentences.en: And I hope you and your family are safe there tonight in Tampa.
sentences.zh: 希望你和你的家人今晚在坦帕平安无事。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Several hours later, I called my colleague Jess Bidgood.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，我给我的同事杰斯·比德古德打了电话。

sentences.en: Jess, you have been reporting from Tampa as the city quite suddenly found itself directly in the path of Hurricane Irma.
sentences.zh: 杰斯，你一直在坦帕进行报道，而这座城市突然发现自己直接处于飓风“艾尔玛”的路径上。

sentences.en: What has the mood been like over the course of the day?
sentences.zh: 这一天下来，那里的气氛如何？

sentences.en: It has been very anxious.
sentences.zh: 非常焦虑。

sentences.en: Tampa is a city that is very vulnerable to a hurricane.
sentences.zh: 坦帕是一座对飓风非常脆弱的城市。

sentences.en: It juts out into the bay.
sentences.zh: 它突出在海湾里。

sentences.en: It's low lying.
sentences.zh: 地势低洼。

sentences.en: A lot of its infrastructure is right on the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 很多基础设施就在海岸边。

sentences.en: And it hasn't been hit with a major hurricane directly in 90 years.
sentences.zh: 而且它已经90年没有受到大型飓风的直接袭击了。

sentences.en: So officials here were very anxious.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的官员们非常焦虑。

sentences.en: They were planning for a disaster on the scale of something that this city hasn't seen in a very long time.
sentences.zh: 他们正在为一场这座城市很久没见过的灾难做准备。

sentences.en: If the wind is consistently and steady at over 40 miles per hour, the Tampa Police Department and the Tampa Fire Department cannot and will not come out and get you.
sentences.zh: 如果风速持续稳定在每小时40英里以上，坦帕警察局和消防局将无法也不会出来救你。

sentences.en: I cannot put the men and women who serve us so bravely in harm's way.
sentences.zh: 我不能让我那些勇敢服务的男男女女们身陷险境。

sentences.en: They will be sheltering just like everyone else will be until the winds subside and then we can come and get you.
sentences.zh: 他们会和其他人一样待在避难所里，直到风力减弱，然后我们才能去救你。

sentences.en: Do not call 911 if the wind is blowing consistently beyond 40 miles per hour because we are not going to be able to come and help you.
sentences.zh: 如果风速持续超过每小时40英里，请不要拨打911，因为我们无法去救你。

sentences.en: People were being turned away at some shelters as they filled up.
sentences.zh: 一些避难所在爆满后开始拒绝接收民众。

sentences.en: There were people in Tampa who had evacuated here from the East Coast and suddenly found themselves in the crosshairs of this thing.
sentences.zh: 坦帕有一些从东海岸撤离过来的人，突然发现自己处于这场风暴的中心。

sentences.en: And so there was a lot of anxiety.
sentences.zh: 所以当时非常焦虑。

sentences.en: And Jess, what are city officials expecting now?
sentences.zh: 杰斯，城市官员现在有什么预期？

sentences.en: We're talking to you around midnight and it feels like there's been a change.
sentences.zh: 我们是在午夜左右和你通话的，感觉情况似乎发生了变化。

sentences.en: It does feel like there's been a change.
sentences.zh: 确实感觉发生了变化。

sentences.en: The storm has been moving over land and it has been weakening.
sentences.zh: 风暴一直在陆地上移动，并且正在减弱。

sentences.en: So city officials who this morning were envisioning a disaster are now talking about something that falls very short of what they had been expecting.
sentences.zh: 所以今天早上还在设想灾难的城市官员们，现在谈论的情况比他们预期的要轻得多。

sentences.en: I spoke with Tom Forward, the chief of Tampa Fire Rescue and the emergency manager of the city.
sentences.zh: 我采访了坦帕消防救援队队长兼城市应急经理汤姆·福沃德。

sentences.en: And he talked me through what they were expecting to find in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他向我讲述了他们预计明天早上会看到的情况。

sentences.en: The type of damage that we're looking for now is going to be not as severe as we had anticipated.
sentences.zh: 我们现在预期的破坏程度不会像我们之前预想的那么严重。

sentences.en: And we were expecting storm surges anywhere from 6 to 15 foot.
sentences.zh: 我们之前预计会有6到15英尺的风暴潮。

sentences.en: Now that's been downgraded to somewhere about 1 to 3 feet.
sentences.zh: 现在已经下调到大约1到3英尺了。

sentences.en: So now we're looking for less water damage and less water intrusion into a number of our buildings, as you might.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在预计水灾会减轻，很多建筑的进水情况也会减少，正如你所料。

sentences.en: And Jess, do you get a sense that everyone there is basically breathing a sigh of relief?
sentences.zh: 杰斯，你觉得那里的人们现在是否都在松一口气？

sentences.en: I think officials here are breathing a very cautious sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里的官员们正在如释重负，但仍保持谨慎。

sentences.en: They don't know for sure yet.
sentences.zh: 他们还不能完全确定。

sentences.en: They're still tracking the storm closely.
sentences.zh: 他们仍在密切追踪风暴。

sentences.en: We are seeing lightning over the city.
sentences.zh: 我们看到城市上空有闪电。

sentences.en: I can see the rain, bands of rain kind of lashing outside.
sentences.zh: 我能看到雨，雨带正在外面猛烈地抽打着。

sentences.en: I can hear the wind.
sentences.zh: 我能听到风声。

sentences.en: But they are watching a storm that is much less catastrophic than what they had expected just hours ago.
sentences.zh: 但他们正在观察的这场风暴，比几个小时前预期的要灾难性得多。

sentences.en: And in the words of Chief Forward, they feel blessed.
sentences.zh: 用福沃德队长的话说，他们感到很幸运。

sentences.en: There was no doubt that there was nothing short of the grace of God that we're not looking at a very horrific Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，如果不是上帝的恩典，我们现在面对的可能就是一个非常可怕的周一早晨。

sentences.en: As of Monday morning, at least four deaths in Florida were attributed to Hurricane Irma,
sentences.zh: 截至周一上午，佛罗里达州至少有四起死亡事件被归因于飓风“艾尔玛”，

sentences.en: which dropped up to 16 inches of rain on parts of the state and left 3.3 million people without electricity.
sentences.zh: 这场飓风在佛州部分地区降下了高达16英寸的雨量，并导致330万人断电。

sentences.en: The weakened storm is now headed for northern Florida.
sentences.zh: 减弱后的风暴目前正向佛罗里达州北部移动。

sentences.en: And by Monday night, it's expected to move into Georgia and Alabama.
sentences.zh: 预计到周一晚上，它将进入佐治亚州和阿拉巴马州。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个关于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代于夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、展示着精美50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间跨越付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》App，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: I don't think there's any doubt that if James Comey had not been fired, we would not have a special counsel.
sentences.zh: 我认为毫无疑问，如果詹姆斯·科米没有被解雇，我们就不会有特别检察官。

sentences.en: So we would not have the Mueller investigation?
sentences.zh: 所以我们就不会有穆勒调查？

sentences.en: We would not have the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 我们就不会有穆勒调查。

sentences.en: We would not have the Mueller investigation in the breath that clearly Mr. Mueller is going.
sentences.zh: 我们就不会有穆勒目前显然正在进行的这项调查。

sentences.en: In his first extended interview since leaving the White House last month, Donald Trump's former chief strategist, Steve Bannon,
sentences.zh: 在上个月离开白宫后的首次深度访谈中，唐纳德·特朗普的前首席战略顾问史蒂夫·班农，

sentences.en: took the unusual step of criticizing the president for firing FBI director James Comey, implying it led to closer scrutiny in Washington of the Trump campaign's ties to Russia.
sentences.zh: 采取了不同寻常的举动，批评总统解雇联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米，暗示此举导致华盛顿对特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯之间的联系进行了更严密的审查。

sentences.en: Someone said to me that you described the firing of James Comey, you're a student of history,
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我，你曾将解雇詹姆斯·科米这件事描述为——你是一位历史研究者——

sentences.en: as the biggest mistake in political history.
sentences.zh: 政治史上最大的错误。

sentences.en: That would probably be too bombastic even for me, but maybe modern political history.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说可能都太夸张了，但或许是现代政治史上最大的错误。

sentences.en: The firing of James Comey was the biggest mistake in modern political history.
sentences.zh: 解雇詹姆斯·科米是现代政治史上最大的错误。

sentences.en: If you're saying that that's associated with me, then I'll leave it at that.
sentences.zh: 如果你说这话与我有关，那我就不多说了。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我，莎拉·凯尼格，将为您讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的人们的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
